claimChecks.claim: Catheter/retractor assembly is withdrawn out the urethra after suprapubic tip externalization
claimChecks.locator: BAUS accepted manuscript p 9 Lowsley method; Edokpolo abstract; Karsh indexed technique context
claimChecks.note: Catheter is gripped at the externalized tip and drawn into bladder; balloon intravesical, instrument alone removed transurethrally.

claimChecks.claim: Palpable tip makes hostile-abdomen Lowsley placement bowel-safe
claimChecks.locator: BAUS p 9 Lowsley warning and bowel-risk section; Karsh indexed discussion
claimChecks.note: BAUS explicitly says Lowsley does not guard against bowel injury; history, imaging or open exposure may be needed.

claimChecks.claim: ~20-minute operative time applies to all 49; selected series has no complications
claimChecks.locator: Primary 2011 abstract results n=49, timed n=19, one next-day hematuria
claimChecks.note: Nineteen timed procedures only; next-day hematuria acknowledged; comparative safety not inferable.

claimChecks.claim: 2.4% bowel injury is blind-only pooled rate and open method has lowest demonstrated risk
claimChecks.locator: BAUS bowel-injury background and procedural options pp 5–12; Jacob abstract
claimChecks.note: Historical mixed-technique SPC estimates; no head-to-head route-specific causal advantage shown.

claimChecks.claim: Lowsley traction prevents tear and validates revision/rendezvous operations
claimChecks.note: Posterior traction described as author-proposed aid, not comparative effect or extension to redo anatomy.

claimChecks.claim: Every Lowsley has same lumen, jaws, material and reusable sterile processing
claimChecks.locator: Avalign Rev C p 1 and pp 2–4; Aspen #51-9998 catalog
claimChecks.note: Specifications and processing must be actual-model-specific; IFU internal sonication tension reported, not resolved for facility.

claimChecks.claim: Inherited AUA-labeled video demonstrates the published procedure and date
claimChecks.note: Card preserved but audiovisual details, presenter and 2024 attribution not independently verified.
